article.title: Application to negotiable instruments.
article.content: The provisions of rules 46A to 46H (both inclusive) shall, so far as may be, apply in relation to negotiable instruments attached under rule 51 as they apply in relation to debts.]
article.html:
46IApplication to negotiable instruments.

Order 21, Rule 46I

The provisions of rules 46A to 46H (both inclusive) shall, so far as may be, apply in relation to negotiable instruments attached under rule 51 as they apply in relation to debts.]
